steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Hey, you're in my way, you know? Look where you're going, idiot!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Why must you park your car next to mine when there are so many spaces left? If you dare scratch my car, I'll ruin yours!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: Are you done taking pictures yet? Is nothing else going on in your brain? Just swap it out for a camera in that case!

A scene of utmost chaos is unfolding. Someone's suddenly pushing a pedestrian, and another person's smashing a car with a crowbar. Someone has even grabbed another person's camera, shoving it into the owner's mouth.
Quarrels and brawls echo throughout the street. Everyone in sight is venting their anger freely. Shocked, Shrooma grips her black smartphone tightly, standing dumbfounded.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: What is this place...?
Shrooma is struck by everything she sees, but the girl beside her is evidently proud of the scene before them. This is her creation, based on Shrooma's wish.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Isn't this the place you've always dreamed of?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I've told you before. The only rule here is joy. Everything here happens only to meet your expectations!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: You're not joking with me, right?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: This isn't some reality show where they put you in a huge glass box, is it? Is this the moment of the big revelation?
L.L. observes Shrooma, whose little face has stiffened, and pinches her cheek sympathetically. She then brushes her hand over the smartphone in Shrooma's hand like she's implying something.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You worry too much for a kid your age. Rest assured, I can guarantee you that no one is monitoring you here. No one is going to judge you or stop you from doing anything!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Haven't you always talked about the life you want on the forum? Now I've created such a place for you. Here, you can do whatever pleases you!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: No more suppressing yourself. Let it all out and get your rebellion!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Let it all out? Rebellion? No way... you know I'm on the forum...?!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You don't need to be afraid. You can post whatever you want. I will support all your ideas!
The girl hides her smartphone behind her back, looking panicked. But L.L.'s smile calms her down, prompting her to think and process the current situation.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: These people are indeed acting according to the fantasies I posted on the forums... You've turned my posts into reality!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: But don't they say no one can crack the anonymity of that forum on the dark web? How did you do it?! No... I can feel that your power is much stronger than mine... Are you not only the creator of this island, but also related to the dark web?!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What a bright kid, you guessed it right! But don't worry. Only I, the master of the forum and the owner of this island, can link you to your account. Your anonymity is intact.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: My intention isn't to uncover your true identity. I just thought it was a shame having to hide and not fully enjoy yourself. I don't want your interesting ideas to go to waste!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: ...You think my ideas are interesting? Even on the dark web, people think I go too far. You don't think this is just some disgusting filth that deserves only to be shoved to the corner or a swamp, out of everyone's sight?
L.L. chuckles as if she has just heard a nonsensical joke.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Filth? Disgusting? Why? Your little ideas are cute and creative!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I don't think they're any different from, say, wishing to binge eat without gaining weight! Elysiland is a place to satisfy everyone's desires. No one should be excluded!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: So go ahead and let out everything you've been hiding! If someone says you only deserve to live in a swamp, then turn the whole world into a swamp! Show them!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Yes! That's exactly what I think! I can't believe you agree with me!
The girl has never had such a pleasant surprise. Her gaze toward L.L. turns friendly. And after L.L. gestures at the thick swamp around the pool, the friendliness turns into reverence.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Of course! I've already told you, your wish is just as worthy as anyone else's!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Besides, you're not alone! Look over there, see those people getting drawn in? They're just as happy about the swamp as you are!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The more content and satisfied you guys are, the more energy this island gains, and the stronger I become! That way, the world you desire will grow even larger too!

More and more people discover the spreading swamp. They gather around to shout angrily and jostle at each other, wreaking havoc. After venting thoroughly, they leave feeling relieved, resuming their gluttonous feasting.
The malice they leave behind slowly settles into the murky swamp, stirring up numerous sticky, filthy muddy bubbles. The swamp expands and engulfs, replacing the beach and coral reefs.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Amazing... The swamp has grown... My habitat is expanding...
Shrooma's smartphone screen lights up at some point, illuminating her ecstatic face. But just then, the island suddenly shakes violently.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Wh-what just happened? My swamp... Did I do something wrong? My swamp just got...!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Easy, it has nothing to do with you. It's just some bad guys trying to take you away!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: A peculiar wish, isn't it? But also a sincere one. So the island will make his wish come true!
steps.female_content: A peculiar wish, isn't it? But also a sincere one. So the island will make her wish come true!

steps.content: L.L. pats Shrooma's head in a comforting manner, still smiling brightly.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: But... if the island is destroyed, what will happen to me and my swamp? I don't want to hide anymore!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: No, I must protect this place, the place where my wishes can come true... I must protect the island owner!

L.L. has clearly won the girl's loyalty, so much so that she's even worrying about losing Elysiland. She clenches her fists, her tone full of unusual energy despite the unsettling darkness underlying her words.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I will turn the entire island into a swamp, and let it sink to the bottom of the sea where no one can reach! That way, I can protect everyone and my swamp!
